headline: Refex Industries & Refex Green Mobility: NCLT-directed amalgamation proceeding; creditor meetings convened under IBC framework
sum: Refex Industries Limited (RIL) initiating amalgamation with Refex Green Mobility Limited (RGML) under NCLT, Chennai Bench direction. Newspaper notice convened meetings of equity shareholders and secured/unsecured creditors of both entities to approve the scheme of amalgamation, signalling a restructuring under the insolvency framework.
detail: The National Company Law Tribunal, Chennai Bench, has directed Refex Industries Limited (transferor) and Refex Green Mobility Limited (transferee) to convene separate class meetings of equity shareholders, secured creditors, and unsecured creditors. This tri-partite structure is typical of IBC Section 230–232 (Scheme of Arrangement) proceedings. The newspaper publication under SEBI (LODR) Regulation 47 is the mandatory disclosure mechanism; the NCLT order itself will specify the scheme terms, merger ratio, and creditor haircuts (if any). No scheme value, consideration ratio, or dissenting creditor relief framework is disclosed in the notice stub.
